metric: nDCG@10, linear gain, queries as in BEIR test qrels, self-matches removed

primary_family.H1: GAINER (main config, per-query budget) has higher macro nDCG@10 than Current Rank (score-based cascade, same survival schedule) at the primary budget on the main backbone.
primary_family.H2: GAINER has higher macro nDCG@10 than SEE (EPT, exit before block 0, delta calibrated on source queries to the same normalized compute) at the primary budget on the main backbone.
primary_family.H3: Cross-query pooled GAINER (pool size 32) has higher macro nDCG@10 than per-query GAINER at the primary budget on the main backbone.

secondary: per-dataset tests (Holm within dataset family), second-backbone replication of H1, ablations (descriptive), measured latency (descriptive)
test: two-sided paired sign-flip randomization test on per-query differences (seed-averaged), stratified by dataset, statistic = macro mean difference; Holm correction over H1-H3; stratified percentile bootstrap 95% CI
